items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Oh, him and I couldn't get along, period, no way.

ctx.x: And the people just clapped and just hollered and everything and she was bashful -- she was something else. So that was his mother.

Then next, this character that was managing, the manager -- a big belly thing, I called him. His name was Frenchie -- and he was so ornery and evil, you know. Oh, him and I couldn't get along, period, no way. So we was in the
hotel and they were supposed to take us out. Everybody. They called everybody to come downstairs.
